tool_args.rationale: The bridge and flux-conservation signatures suggest coupled transfer, but fixed H, x_now, u_past and mem_conv leave transient and input dependencies unidentified. A trajectory batch can discriminate the dynamics before confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a stationary nonlinear flux law
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The seven observations vary primarily u_now, with only two additional gradient values; they do not identify horizon or initial-state dependence.
All observations have the same horizon and initial state, leaving the coupled dynamics underdetermined.
The nuisance measurement does not resolve the mechanism.
